We’ve got a few easy ways to test the waters so you can find what fits you and your pup.

Try small first: You can grab our meals online at PetSmart, Amazon, or Chewy, or in select PetSmart stores. They also offer variety and single packs so your dog can taste-test.
Sample packs: New customers can use a Variety Pack through Chewy or Amazon, or mix-and-match single packs at PetSmart to see which recipe your dog loves.
Full subscription trial: When you’re ready, you can start a personalized meal plan on our site. We’ll build portions based on your dog’s age, weight, and activity level, and you’ll begin with a two‑week trial before regular deliveries.

That way you can start small, see what your pup likes, and only then commit to a subscription if it feels right.
